name: Ashiato Hotel
description: Ashiato Hotel is a serene WordPress theme crafted for dog-friendly seaside guesthouses, inspired by clean Japanese hospitality aesthetics. It features an inset photo hero window with gentle cross-fading imagery, pale sage paw-print trails, quick-answer FAQ cards, and structured rates tables. Designed with accessible sans typography and dedicated dog-stay block patterns, it presents a calm, practical home for hotels where dogs are welcomed as true guests.

summary.en: A hotel theme for guests who travel with dogs: an inset rounded photo window that cross-fades four arrival moments under a huge light headline, a pale sage paw trail, quick-answer tiles, room rows, an inset parallax dog-run window and an FAQ accordion.
